name: Default Quality Rules
description: Standard BIM model quality checks: naming, required parameters, and model health.

rules.name: Wall Naming Convention
rules.description: Wall type names must not be default/unnamed (e.g., 'Wall 1', 'Generic'). Should describe material or function.

rules.name: Level Naming Convention
rules.description: Level names must not be Revit defaults like 'Level 1'. Should have a meaningful name (L1, Ground Floor, etc.)

rules.name: View Naming Convention
rules.description: View names must not contain default suffixes like 'Copy', 'Kopya', or auto-numbered sections

rules.name: Fire Rating Required
rules.description: All walls should have a Fire Rating parameter filled in for code compliance

rules.name: Mark Required for Doors
rules.description: All doors must have a Mark parameter

rules.name: Room Number Required
rules.description: All rooms must have a Number parameter filled in

rules.name: Duplicate View Names
rules.description: Detects views with identical names (indicates unorganized views)

rules.name: Unplaced Rooms
rules.description: Detects rooms with zero area (unplaced or with open boundaries)
